subject: Youth events this Ramadan
snippet:
Asalamualakim everyone:
 
 Per our conversation during the last council meeting we have 3 youth events
 in the works so far:
 1) youth boys lock in on May 25
 2) youth girls lock in on May 26
 3) youth iftar on June 3
 
 Attached you will find flyers

Asalmualikum Br. Ashraf,
 
 Attached you will find Maryam Masjid's carnival flyer. Please give us a
 quote on 2 banners and 1000 (5" by 7") fliers.
 
 Fliers need to be printed according to ISGH guidelines.
 
 
 Jazakallah Khair
 
 Dua Quraishi
